title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 4: The Line We Hold
description: Beyond the storm’s crack, Jonathan must learn when to hold on—and when to listen. Recover a sample, a route, or both at a cost. A story-led expedition with lasting material outcomes, without points.

continuity: The child from episode 1 is safe with her mother.
Jonathan, An and Q travel to Neri for water; Min is an adult with an ill wife; Tao is the pump worker.
Episode 2 has four outcomes: Tao dead/all water/Q alive; everyone alive/half water; everyone alive/no water/Tao offers a lead; Tao alive/all water/Q destroyed and recording lost.

The source of the repeated voice remains unexplained. Do not resurrect Tao or Q or restore the lost recording without an explicitly selected compatible route.

Episode 3: three preparations from pump inspection, both-community hearing, voluntary household reserve contribution and evacuation. Shared management requires inspection and hearing and costs four buckets.
Mei survives only if evacuated early or treated with four buckets; otherwise she dies. Do not resurrect her.
Hill control costs six buckets; emergency distribution breaks a prior promise if made; shared management renegotiates it by consent. Carry the actual agreement and remaining water forward.
Episode 4 confirms a valid Episode 3 continuity snapshot before play; it preserves exact drinking water, earlier deaths, agreement, promise and An’s previous testimony.
Jonathan and An return from the crack unharmed after isolating a damaged western pipe. Its sample is for testing, never drinking supply.

Episode 4 evidence: bottle = sample and rope retained, no route; diagram = remembered/copied route and rope retained, no sample; both = sample and route, anchored rope sacrificed. Only prior anchoring unlocks both.
Jonathan respects An’s stop signal and lets her make the first record. The closed western station still sends water; its cause, the earlier voice and deep reserve remain unexplained.

teaser.imagePrompt: Preserve approved anime Jonathan and An. Dawn rocky ravine, exposed pipe, taut rescue rope, An raises STOP signal; unresolved decision, no injury, no text.
teaser.prompt: Animate this exact shonen anime image, preserving both adult faces and clothing. One continuous six-second shot, fixed camera. Jonathan holds the taut rescue rope firmly and turns his concerned eyes toward An. An holds her open hand steadily in a STOP signal. Both keep their feet planted on their respective sides of the crack. Only gentle wind moves robes and hair, and a little dust falls into the crack. Do not widen the crack, pull either person across, make anyone fall, add people, or resolve the decision. Maintain the rope connection to An’s waist. No speech, narration, voices, music, words or text. Keep mouths closed. Native audio is quiet wind, rope tension and small falling stones only.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Today An and I go to investigate the crack beneath the hill.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Does your hand still hurt? Let me help.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: My hand does not hurt. But you cannot choose for me.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I hesitate. She does not wait for my help.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Then what do you ask of me?
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I am afraid of a friend dying.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Today you are in charge; I will listen.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: When I say stop, listen first. Do not pull me at once.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: All right. I promise to listen first.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I am afraid too. But protecting a friend does not mean choosing for them.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I stop blocking her way.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Do not joke. Listening is more than just nodding.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Then I will need plenty of patience.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: We walk slowly. Yesterday’s choices have not disappeared.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Today we inspect the pipe. We leave the stored water untouched; water here cannot be drunk.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: There is a pipe by the crack. It has water, but not much.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: There really is water? Enough for everyone?
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: We do not know yet. First close this valve to protect the stored water.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I close the valve. Dirty water from here can no longer reach the houses.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I will examine the record on the pipe. You stay here and handle the rope.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Anchor the rope first, or examine the water?
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: If we anchor the rope, I can carry more. But if the stone moves, we cannot recover the rope.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: If we examine the water first, we will know what to look for. But you cannot let go of the rope.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Anchor the rope so she can carry more.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: There is sand in the cup. This is different from the stored water.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The water comes from the west. First examine the western pipe.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The record says there is an old station to the west. This is a broken pipe, not a reservoir.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Why did you want to come?
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Why is it not a reservoir?
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I can repair pipes, not just record what you say.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I asked you to answer for me, and almost underestimated you.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The water is inside the pipe, coming from the west. There is no other water here.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I look at the water. You look at its route.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: I want to pull her back. But she has said stop. I watch and wait for her to speak.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Listen. I can get back. The cup has water; I have not finished reading the record.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: If I return first, I can bring the water, but no record. If I put down the cup, I can learn the whole route, then return.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Return with the water now. Leave the record.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: She returns with water, but no record. We still have the rope.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The cup is put down. I will read the record; wait patiently.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Then do not try to protect the rope. I can do it; trust me.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: She brings back water and the record. The stone traps the rope, and we let it go.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: You are back.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Yes. I told you I could do it.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: My hands are still shaking. She does not make a joke.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: When we return, you speak and I will listen.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: When I am afraid, I will talk to you first.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: We will speak together. We experienced it together. Just do not answer for me.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: Good. Talking is better than giving orders.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: We return and record where the broken pipe is. Everyone is safe today.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.text: The record has the route to the old station in the west. There is a part there for repairing the pipe.
englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.

englishAudioOverrides.reason: Free on-device completion; existing provider receipts preserved; no network calls.
